answer: A payout is split so that 22% arrives at settlement and the rest over 8 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. The inlet schedule is applied in copper and ferrous reveals each instalment. Someone thus cannot take the money and run, as most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A farm of 4166 identities would post 3348 proofs and burn roughly 18 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
